question: With the accepted one-aircraft A02 schedule, does moving only the second OperationProfile.STIM from h20 to h9.5, while retaining its one-third-hour DTIM, cause that mission to time out before the first aircraft returns at h10, leaving the first and third successful missions intact?

accepted_parent.scope: one aircraft, three fixed mission starts h8/h20/h32 and completions h10/h22/h34, 34 sealed local raw files

source.manual_interpretation: For a fixed mission, STIM is its scheduled start, NOPER advances allocation and DTIM is maximum start delay. If minimum systems are unavailable and unprepared at STIM+DTIM, the mission is cancelled. Here h9.5+one-third hour is before the accepted first h10 return. The precise cancellation event time and resultant ledgers are to be observed, not assumed.

source_delta.only_changed_cell: OperationProfile second BASIC-SCHEDULE/BASIC-MISSION row STIM 20 to 9.5 hours
source_delta.retained: first/third STIM h8/h32, DURN 2 hours, NOPER 1 hour, DTIM one third hour, one physical TEACH-AIR-01, 36 hour horizon, half-hour collection, seed, and all other 178 authored cells

predeclared_acceptance: Independent contract GO before child construction; accepted A01/A02 parent source, signoffs, indexes and 68 local raw seals plus the published at-return sibling must remain pinned and unmodified.

Freeze an exact one-cell STIM 20-to-9.5 child among 179 authored cells, strict parent diff, parent negative control for the proposed timeout gate, exact 13 row-containing-table import/export checker, full event/report validator and unique guarded SSH0 runner. No accepted or published native run is repeated.

Immediately before the sole native child require actual SSH session0/sshd ancestry, free Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, absent unique run directory, no conflicting native process, and the responsive GUI's actual PID/session/exact start identity. Freeze source SHA before/after and preserve every failed byte if any gate fails.

Converter must have zero errors with classified warnings; import/export must retain all authored tables and exact STIM h8/h9.5/h32. Any unexpected rejection, missing output or short report is NO_GO and must be sealed without reusing the directory.

Require first mission h8-10 and third h32-34 successful and unchanged in physical identity/event lines. The second must be created and request the sole aircraft, then fail to start because it remains unavailable through the h9.8333 deferment deadline; require a native cancellation or explicit timeout marker tied to mission identity 1, no second task/launch/success, and no unrelated cancellation. Classify the observed order and timestamp; do not infer a general event rule.

Reconcile each field of all 72 half-hour System rows, 72 Stock rows and the 11 summary fields from the raw event/state ledger. Require exactly two completed sorties, four flight hours, one ready aircraft at terminal state, and explain any changed bins from the accepted parent and at-return sibling. No after-run gate relaxation.

Separate independent read-only replay must verify source/raw SHA and size pins, the cancellation reason and timeline, complete ledgers and terminal state without importing the author validator. Bounded signoff, staged and remote review and authorized PR/merge are required for publication.
limits: One fixed-seed, one-aircraft, insufficient-gap arm only; no generic cancellation boundary, other deferments, stochastic duration, multiple aircraft, full A02.var01 or Issue18 claim.
No GUI visual, cross-engine or performance claim. K01/K08 capture and K06 remain blocked; I07 opening-stock-three and E05.var02 exact-time remain excluded.
